review:
Classic Big Bass with a second bonus bolted on. The regular free spins work as usual – the fisherman collects, every four retrigger and raise the multiplier.

The new bit is a hold and spin from three coins in the base game: coins stick, new coins reset your lives, and values add up when the lives run out, with diamonds adding bigger prizes. Two bonuses means more variety. Up to 10,000x, 96.07% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
